mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidney does more than just remove waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because their slots and connections were already named.

surprise.text: I was surprised that glucose and water pass through the filter along with waste and then need to be taken back.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing how filtering, recovery and the route to the bladder fit together made me curious about how other body systems work.
